name: Stathis 2018 IMGN529 NCA Replay and Exploratory Dose-Level PK Surrogate
description: Complete exact article/supplement replay plus paper-endpoint exponential probes and a separate exploratory aggregate calibration. The calibrated ODE jointly summarizes dose dependence in all eight Table 4 Cmax, AUCinf, and half-life means; it is not a paper-reported PopPK/TMDD model.
